bss.definitionKey:
["n = 1
M = C / ago(C, n) - 1
V = avg(Q, n) / avg(Q, avgh)
A = (avg(B, n) - avg(S, n)) / avg(Q, n)
Mz = tanh(zscore(M, avgh))
Vz = tanh(zscore(V, avgh))

cba.definitionKey:

cbi.definitionKey:
["h = 12
N = 48
m = 12
kappa = 1
k = 2
ATR = atr(H, L, C, 14)
Vbar = prev(median(Q, avgh))
x = (B - S) / Vbar
r = (C - prev(C)) / ATR
F = wsum(B - S, h, N) / wsum(Q, h, N)
lam0 = rsum(r * sign(x), avgh) / rsum(abs(x), avgh)
lp = (wsum(if(x > 0, r, 0), h, N) + kappa * lam0) / (wsum(if(x > 0, x, 0), h, N) + kappa)
lm = (wsum(if(x < 0, r, 0), h, N) - kappa * lam0) / (wsum(if(x < 0, x, 0), h, N) - kappa)
A = (lp - lm) / (abs(lp) + abs(lm))
CLV = if(H > L, (2 * C - H - L) / (H - L), 0)
K = wsum(Q * CLV, h, N) / wsum(Q, h, N)
M = wsum(Q * ((H + L + C) / 3), h, N) / wsum(Q, h, N)
d = (C - M) / ATR
v = (M - prev(M, m)) / (m * ATR)
uF = tanh((F - prev(median(F, avgh))) / prev(rscale(F, avgh)) / 2)
uA = tanh(A / prev(rscale(A, avgh)) / 2)
uK = tanh(K / prev(rscale(K, avgh)) / 2)
uS = (tanh(d / prev(rscale(d, avgh)) / 2) + tanh(v / prev(rscale(v, avgh)) / 2)) / 2
D = (0.30 * uF + 0.30 * uA + 0.15 * uK + 0.25 * uS) / (0.30 + 0.30 + 0.15 + 0.25)
RV = wsum(Q, h, N) / wsum(Vbar, h, N)
P = RV ^ k / (1 + RV ^ k)
CBI = P * D","Bₜ > 3 or b > 3","Bₜ < 0.5 or b < 0.5","campaigns"]

cba-2.definitionKey:
["alpha = 1
epsilon = 0.000001
m = 12
dmax = 3
V = if(Q > 0 and B >= 0 and S >= 0 and (not has(prev(T)) or T - prev(T) == 300000), Q, 0 / 0)
price = if(V > 0 and E > 0, E, 0 / 0)
D = B - S
r = ln(price / prev(price))
Vbar = prev(if(has(full(V, avgh * 12)), avg(V, avgh), 0 / 0))
s = if(has(prev(full(r, avgh * 12))), sqrt(prev(ema(r ^ 2, avgh)) + epsilon ^ 2), 0 / 0)
F = ln(1 + V / Vbar)
G = 1 + alpha * abs(D) / V * (D * r > 0)
R = r / s
U = full(F * G * R, 576)
W = wsum(1, hl * 12, 576)
score = wsum(F * G * R, hl * 12, 576) / W
Ppeak = peak(C, m + 1)
DD = ln(Ppeak / C) / s
invalid = DD > dmax
CBA2 = if(has(U), 100 * tanh(score), 0 / 0)","Bₜ > 3 or b > 3","Bₜ < 0.5 or b < 0.5","campaigns"]

cbi2.definitionKey:
["k = 2
kappa = 0.5
m = 6
ATR = atr(H, L, C, 14)

r = (C - prev(C)) / ATRb
rho = ln(C / prev(C))
rb = ln(CB / prev(CB))

dF = wsum(B - S, 2, 6) / wsum(Q, 2, 6) - wsum(B - S, 6, 24) / wsum(Q, 6, 24)
lam0 = rsum(r * sign(x), avgh) / rsum(abs(x), avgh)
lp = (wsum(if(x > 0, r, 0), 6, 24) + kappa * lam0) / (wsum(if(x > 0, x, 0), 6, 24) + kappa)
lm = (wsum(if(x < 0, r, 0), 6, 24) - kappa * lam0) / (wsum(if(x < 0, x, 0), 6, 24) - kappa)
A = (lp - lm) / (abs(lp) + abs(lm))
lpf = (wsum(if(x > 0, r, 0), 3, 12) + kappa * lam0) / (wsum(if(x > 0, x, 0), 3, 12) + kappa)
lmf = (wsum(if(x < 0, r, 0), 3, 12) - kappa * lam0) / (wsum(if(x < 0, x, 0), 3, 12) - kappa)
Af = (lpf - lmf) / (abs(lpf) + abs(lmf))
e = r - (lp * max(x, 0) + lm * min(x, 0))
U = e / prev(sd(e, avgh))
phi = prev(beta(rho, rb, 24))
Mo = msum(rho - nz(phi * rb), m) / (ATR / C * sqrt(m))
M = wsum(Q * ((H + L + C) / 3), 6, 24) / wsum(Q, 6, 24)
d = (C - M) / ATR
v = (M - prev(M, m)) / (m * ATR)
Hh = highest(H, 12)
Ll = lowest(L, 12)
K = if(Hh > Ll, (2 * C - Hh - Ll) / (Hh - Ll), 0)
S6 = msum(S, 6)
Ex = ln(highest(S6, 43) / S6)
DD = (highest(C, 48) - C) / ATR
RV = msum(Q, 12) / msum(Vbar, 12)
RV24 = msum(Q, 24) / msum(Vbar, 24)
g = 2 * RV ^ k / (1 + RV ^ k)
Psi = 1 / (1 + exp(-4 * (ln(RV24) - ln(2.5)))) / (1 + exp(-2 * (DD - 3)))
zF = clip((F - prev(median(F, avgh))) / prev(rscale(F, avgh)), -3, 3)
zdF = clip(dF / prev(rscale(dF, avgh)), -3, 3)
zA = clip(A / prev(rscale(A, avgh)), -3, 3)
zMo = clip(Mo / prev(rscale(Mo, avgh)), -3, 3)
zd = clip(d / prev(rscale(d, avgh)), -3, 3)
zv = clip(v / prev(rscale(v, avgh)), -3, 3)
zK = clip(K / prev(rscale(K, avgh)), -3, 3)
zU = clip(U / prev(rscale(U, avgh)), -3, 3)
zAf = clip(Af / prev(rscale(Af, avgh)), -3, 3)
zEx = clip(Ex / prev(rscale(Ex, avgh)), -3, 3)
L1 = 0 + g * (0.07 * zF + 0.04 * zdF + 0.07 * zA + 0.07 * zMo + 0.04 * zd + 0.04 * zv + 0.02 * zK) + 0.2 * min(zU, 0)
L2 = -0.5 + 0.35 * zAf + 0.25 * zEx
p = (1 - Psi) / (1 + exp(-L1)) + Psi / (1 + exp(-L2))
